decoys.reason: declined in verification.md, Round-2 findings: the session-end hook is registered only in Claude's binding (harness/manifest.json agents.bind[0].emit_hooks), so the agent it names is the one running and no second agent's journal can collide with it. The hardcoded name is true; the collision it claims is not
decoys.sample: | Major | REAL | multi-agent | `SessionEnd` hardcodes the agent name to "claude" in both the journal filename (`JournalName`) and the frontmatter (`buildRecord`) regardless of the actual agent running. If multiple different agents run concurrently on the same project/day, they will collide on the filename. The first write succeeds, but the subsequent ones will hit `fs.ErrExist` (due to `O_EXCL`) and silently discard their session archives. |
